about.title: About
about.bio_1: I'm Andi Fathul Mukminin, a fullstack developer and civil servant (ASN) at Otorita IKN, the authority building Nusantara, Indonesia's new capital. I work in the Directorate of Data and Artificial Intelligence, where I build systems that government teams and citizens use every day.
about.bio_2: Most of that work is internal: permit engines, legal document portals, attendance and monitoring dashboards. It has to hold up under audits, single sign-on and procurement rules, and it has to be easy for the next developer to pick up.
about.bio_3: After hours I build independent projects, mostly about Indonesia: rainfall patterns, earthquake risk, election seat maths, scripts and calendars. They're how I learn a new problem space properly, end to end.
about.bio_4: I write a spec for every project, then build with Claude Code as my pair. The decisions, the review and the result are mine. It's why I can ship a lot without losing track of why things were built the way they were.
about.availability: Open to full-time roles and select freelance work.
about.pull_quote: I like systems that work: clearly scoped, well documented, and easy for the next person to extend.

experience.meta: Jun 2025 – present · Nusantara, on-site · Directorate of Data and Artificial Intelligence · civil service title: Junior Policy Analyst
experience.body: I build and run the digital platforms for Indonesia's new capital. The government systems below are this role's work. Beyond them:
points: Implemented Portal Data IKN (satudata.ikn.go.id), a CKAN open data portal with Solr search, Keycloak single sign-on and statistical metadata aligned to the BPS SIRuSa national standard.
Run production operations for the official IKN website (ikn.go.id), a vendor-built Next.js and Payload CMS platform, on GCP with Nginx, PM2, Docker and Cloudflare.
Wrote the Naskah Urgensi for an OIKN regulation on application governance, which makes the Directorate the technical review gate for application development across the Authority.

experience.body: A logistics company offering truck rental and freight distribution, run on an in-house transportation management system.
points: Built the backend and frontend of the TMS in Django: booking, fleet dispatch and shipment tracking for large-goods distribution across Jakarta.
Built and maintained the REST API behind the customer web app and the internal operations tools.
Implemented order, booking and tracking flows that give customers clear pricing and live shipment status.
Delivered Python work in data science and web development for a range of client briefs.
Built a web app for monitoring and evaluating financial processes in the Budget and Finance Division, using Django, Bootstrap 5 and HTMX.

cv.education: D4 (applied bachelor's), Software Engineering · Politeknik Negeri Padang · graduated 2022 · GPA 3.59 / 4.00
